answer: Mechanism: basalt-hashed ripple-thread pricing. Each agent gets a message thread; per-action priority cost is P_i = p0 + λ·corr(i) + μ·|C_i|^1.3, where C_i is the cluster sharing a basalt hash of ASN, code hash, and timing. Correlated sybils face superlinear compute and propagation latency; their actions ripple through a shared delay queue, so adding identities raises marginal cost per identity. Independent agents remain near p0. Attacker cost scales as k^1.3 in compute and k·delay.
